chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Masʿūd al-ʿAyyāshī narrated, saying: Muḥammad ibn Nuṣayr narrated to us; he said: Sahl ibn Ziyād narrated to us; he said: Manṣūr ibn al-ʿAbbās narrated to me; he said: Ismāʿīl ibn Sahl narrated to us, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said: A slave is jointly owned among a group of people—are they liable regarding him for zakat al-fiṭrah?

He عليه السلام said: If each person has a full head, then he must pay his zakat al-fiṭrah for him. And if the number of slaves and the number of masters are equal, and they are all together, then they are equal: they pay their zakat, each one of them according to the measure of his share. And if each person among them has less than a head, then there is nothing upon them.

key_terms.الْمَوَالِي: the owners or masters in relation to the slaves
key_terms.رَأْسٌ: a full individual person counted as one complete head
key_terms.رَقِيقٌ: a slave or bondsman held in ownership
key_terms.زَكَاةُ الْفِطْرَةِ: the obligatory alms of fiṭrah due at the end of Ramadan

ai.seo_question: When is zakat al-fiṭrah due for a slave jointly owned by several people?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling on zakat al-fiṭrah for a slave jointly owned by multiple people. The obligation depends on the extent of ownership: a full head incurs payment, equal shared ownership entails proportional payment, and ownership less than a full head does not entail liability.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2082 - It is narrated by Muhammad ibn Mas'ud Al-Ayyashi, who said: Muhammad ibn Nusair narrated to us, saying: Sahl ibn Ziyad narrated to us, saying: Mansur ibn Al-Abbas narrated to us, saying: Isma'il ibn Sahl narrated from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara, from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
I asked him about slaves shared among a group of people, whether Zakat al-Fitr is obligatory on them.

Imam (as) said: "If each person owns a full share (equivalent to one head), then he must pay Zakat al-Fitr for that share. However, if the number of slaves and owners are equal and they are collectively owned, then they are equal in responsibility, and each must pay Zakat al-Fitr proportionate to their share. But if each person's share is less than a full head, then there is no obligation upon them."
